events.title: #6 June Devlog: Anatomy of a Fight
events.summary: Hello again, we're back, again... :P We haven't shared a lot about the GrimKeep gameplay, so let's take a look at the basics. GrimKeep Gameplay You traverse a world via a node map. You'll recognize this style of map from other games in the genre. The majority of nodes on this map will be combats, but there will also be random encounters, various shops, and the much needed recovery of a campfire. events.title: Character Art
events.summary: In GrimKeep you will encounter several enemies with different sizes and abilities. In this video we focus on Taurus, an enemy designed specifically to introduce the "Charge Up" ability, where he skips a turn but his next attack will deal a huge blow.

events.title: Character Art
events.summary: There will be several playable characters in GrimKeep, each with their own abilities and playstyle. They’re loosely based on characters from the old Grimm fairytales reimagined through a darker, Lovecraftian lens. Check out our take on Rapunzel.

events.title: Character Art
events.summary: GrimKeep will have a shop you can find along the way where you'll be able to pay for items with both gold 🪙 and blood🩸 But the question that lingers is…How did the shopkeeper get there?How did he survive the countless enemies along the path?And most of all ... why does he need my blood? Hope you enjoy the video, and let us know what you’d like to see next!

events.title: DEVLOG #04
events.summary: We’re back! Sorry for the radio silence 😅 Before summer vacation, our goal was to build a “vertical slice” of GrimKeep, basically a small, playable demo that shows every key part of the game, like a cake slice that lets you see all the layers. It’s enough to feel how the game really plays so we can test things and see what needs tweaking. To make that happen, we paused socials and devlogs to put all our energy into development. We’re a small team, so even small tasks have to be carefully priorit

events.title: DEVLOG #03
events.summary: Let’s talk about the cast of GrimKeep! In this update, we’re diving into the kinds of characters you’ll meet: heroes, villains, and the unfortunate folks in between. In GrimKeep, there’s a clear divide between the good guys and the bad guys. No grey morality or narrative twists to wrestle with, just a classic, grim showdown between light and dark. events.title: DEVLOG #02
events.summary: Developing the art of GrimKeep Early stages Initially the GrimKeep project existed only as a concept of game mechanics; the idea of using dice and yatzy/poker combos as a start and a core, and building on it with "items". The simplicity of the dice would be a super-approachable start for everyone, with minimal need for tutorials.
